source_derivation.window_rule: Begin with the whole-owner support shells of the centered DO endpoint a=1/3 in the specified canonical host; order shell ties by squared world-center radius then lexicographic integer owner word. Retain the first n complete owners. Continue this SAME word set through Eq12 while solving all actual host-wall equations with one shared translation and scale.
source_derivation.native_clearance: All ideal owner centers relative to the common host center are dilated by1+2e-6; scale=(1+2e-6)*nominal+2e-6. Unit octahedra remain unchanged in size.
